record.one_liner: Customer support platform (helpdesk, issues, accounts, knowledge base) for B2B teams, with a REST API and an official MCP server.
record.auth_notes: Public REST API uses a Bearer API token created by an Admin in Settings > Integrations & dev > API. The official MCP server also accepts OAuth 2.0, but that is for MCP clients, not the public REST API.
record.access_notes: critic: access self_serve_free -> paid_plan. Pricing page lists API under the paid Professional plan ($89/seat, annual); the pricing FAQ says free trials are only arranged through a sales representative and pylon-facts says there is no free plan. No self-serve free or trial path to the API.
record.api_notes: Regional base URLs (US api.usepylon.com, EU api.eu.usepylon.com). Reference covers accounts, knowledge bases, custom fields, tags, me and other objects with read and write endpoints.
record.blocker_notes: critic: verdict ready -> blocked. API tokens need a paid Pylon workspace (Professional and up); no free plan, trials are sales-led demo orgs.
